name: Protected paths
description: Refuses missions and locks on files that agents must never change, such as .env files or the deploy configuration. An example of a module rule: it can only refuse, never allow.

settings.label: Protected paths, one per line (* matches part of a name, ** any part of a path: e.g. .env* or infra/**)
Explanation shown to the agent
settings.default: This path is protected: ask a human to change it.
